rule: GOAL: Fill the bottom slots to match the target color sequence shown above. CONTROLS: Click a color in the palette to select it, then click a slot to place it. RULE: The order of colors in the top row dictates the required order for the bottom slots. TRAP: Assuming the palette order matches the goal order wastes time; always check the target sequence first.

GOAL: Move the square to the center dot. CONTROLS: Click a dot to jump the square along the diagonal path. RULE: Jumps are capped at three dots; clicking too far away does nothing. TRAP: Assuming any visible dot is a valid target wastes actions on unreachable spots.

GOAL: Navigate to the exit by moving across the grid. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player. RULE: Each move swaps your position with the tile two steps away. TRAP: Believing you can move one step at a time, when you must always leap two spaces.

GOAL: Guide two colored dots to their matching target centers to open the gate. CONTROLS: Click directional arrows to move the active dot three spaces in that direction. RULE: Dots only interact with targets of the same color, ignoring the other color entirely. TRAP: Assuming arrows affect all dots simultaneously; they only control the currently selected color.

GOAL: Align the object's yellow edge with the wall's gap to clear the level. CONTROLS: Click the bottom blue button to move the object left by four columns per press. RULE: The gray region's top and bottom boundaries maintain a constant sum, shifting in opposite directions. TRAP: Assuming the gray shape is static; it actually shears dynamically as you move the object.

GOAL: Match the blue strip's shapes to the pink slots by cycling through options. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the cursor and change the selected shape's index. RULE: Shapes cycle forward on DOWN and backward on UP, allowing the shortest path. TRAP: Assuming UP is invalid or only DOWN works wastes actions; UP saves time on high indices.

GOAL: Move two purple squares together to merge them into a yellow one. CONTROLS: Click near a square to drag it up, down, left, or right. RULE: Squares snap together automatically when their centers come within six units of each other. TRAP: Assuming you must align them perfectly on the same column; approaching within range on any axis triggers the merge.

GOAL: Position the bar so spreading water falls into both cup notches. CONTROLS: Arrows move the bar horizontally; space releases the water. RULE: Water spreads four units beyond each bar end, creating two falling streams. TRAP: Assuming streams fall directly under the bar edges ignores the four-unit lateral spread.

GOAL: Align the key with the green gap. CONTROLS: Click left to shift the middle, click right to shift the edge. RULE: Each move shifts boundaries by four units in opposite directions. TRAP: Assuming sliders move independently ignores their linked constraints.

GOAL: Align three adjacent target squares into a single wide rectangle. CONTROLS: Clicks moved pieces; space triggered a validation scan. RULE: The scan reveals mismatches by flashing red where a piece does not fit the merged target shape. TRAP: Assuming the red flash indicates a wrong piece; it actually highlights the correct column where the gap exists.

GOAL: Clear Level 1 by performing three specific actions to trigger the completion flash. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the marker; actions trigger the green flash pattern required for progress. RULE: The green flash signals a successful step, but the level only completes after three distinct successes. TRAP: Do not assume a single flash wins; the cord growth is capped, so ignore visual size changes and focus on action count.

GOAL: Navigate the grid safely to the exit without being caught by the enemy. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one cell at a time in the corresponding direction. RULE: Enemies instantly attack if you enter their line of sight or adjacent cells. TRAP: Assuming enemies stay still; they actively hunt you, so moving directly toward them is fatal.

GOAL: Rotate yellow tiles to match the shape of pink symbols in the same order. CONTROLS: Left and right arrows rotate the selected yellow tile; up and down arrows move the cursor between tiles. RULE: Ignore orientation and mirroring; only the underlying geometric shape matters when matching pink to yellow. TRAP: Believing mirrored or rotated pink symbols represent unique letters causes wasted moves trying to find non-existent matches.

GOAL: Move colored markers into matching slots by reading their rectangular borders. CONTROLS: Press Space to flash the next target slot and reveal its required marker; click two slots to swap their contents. RULE: Only the slot with a flashing border indicates the next required marker, dictating the correct swap. TRAP: Assuming static positions or colors match without triggering the flash sequence to confirm the current requirement.

GOAL: Clear the level by clicking the single correct key to complete the circuit. CONTROLS: Click a key to toggle its state and check for a match. RULE: Only the key directly beneath the plug’s leg connects the power source to the socket. TRAP: Assuming keys align with checkerboard columns wasted time; only vertical proximity to the yellow plug matters.

GOAL: Shrink the marker to fit the narrow channel, then reach the head. CONTROLS: Arrows move the marker; clicks select cells in the grid to match the small pattern. RULE: Completing the pattern reduces the marker’s size, allowing it to pass through tight spaces. TRAP: Assuming the pattern is optional wastes time; the marker remains too large for the channel without it.

GOAL: Decode the hidden message by matching rotated symbols to the reference table. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the cursor to select and rotate glyphs for comparison. RULE: Symbols are valid only if their pixel count and shape match a table entry exactly under any rotation. TRAP: Assuming symbols appear in a fixed orientation wastes time; always check all four rotations before rejecting a match.

GOAL: Align three colored keys to specific height gates by balancing fluid levels across five connected pockets. CONTROLS: Clicking the handle between two adjacent pockets transfers two units of fluid from the right pocket to the left one. RULE: Total fluid remains constant; you must move mass leftward to raise low targets while draining high ones, respecting wall heights. TRAP: Believing you must fill pockets from left to right; this causes overflow against walls and wastes moves on unnecessary back-and-forth.

GOAL: Place two shapes fully inside separate circles. CONTROLS: Click to move pieces; merge pieces to form larger shapes. RULE: Shapes must be entirely within circle boundaries, not just touching. TRAP: Believing overlap was enough; partial coverage fails, forcing extra moves to center pieces.

GOAL: Clear the path by landing on the stationary guard to collect it, then reach the exit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one step in the pressed direction. RULE: Landing on a stationary guard collects it safely; only moving guards lunge into you. TRAP: Assuming guards block all adjacent cells; they are harmless until they actively move.

GOAL: Place three boxes onto the glowing bar's slots to complete the level. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the head; Space grabs or releases the held box. RULE: The neck points in the direction of your last move, determining where the box attaches. TRAP: Placing a box permanently consumes the bar's slot, so you cannot move it once placed.

GOAL: Arrange colors in sequence, ignoring the fixed green marker at G1. CONTROLS: Click palette squares to select colors; click slots to place them. RULE: The fixed green piece is decoration, not part of the seven-slot sequence. TRAP: Assuming the hollow palette square was disabled because green was already placed.

GOAL: Rotate and shift symbols to match target patterns across multiple color layers. CONTROLS: Arrows rotated the current symbol clockwise or counter-clockwise to align its shape. RULE: Each color layer acted as a chain; the right side of one pair became the left side of the next. TRAP: Assuming all symbols in the target strip were valid options; some were distractors with mismatched pixel counts.

GOAL: Fill nine target slots with specific colored blocks and connectors to match the pattern. CONTROLS: Click palette items to select, then click empty slots to place; press space to confirm. RULE: Hollow blue connectors act as placeholders that satisfy any target color requirement. TRAP: Assuming connectors are distinct colors; treating them as fixed values blocks progress.

GOAL: Fill the top row with specific shapes and the blue box with colors. CONTROLS: Click a shape, then click a slot to place it; press space to submit. RULE: Only hollow connectors bridge gaps between solid shapes in the top row. TRAP: Thinking you can place solid shapes directly next to each other without a connector.

GOAL: Reach the exit while avoiding a sweeping orange guard and collecting the red one. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one step; the guard patrols horizontally. RULE: You cannot occupy a cell if the guard is there now or will be there next turn. TRAP: Stepping onto the guard's future position causes a collision, even if the cell looks empty when you start the move.

GOAL: Float the key to the yellow gate by transferring water and the object across chambers. CONTROLS: Click water sources to raise levels; click open gates to move the key. RULE: Gates open only when water levels on both sides are equal and high enough. TRAP: Assuming the key stays in place when water rises; it floats up, requiring precise level matching to move it through gates.

GOAL: Align the yellow cross with matching dots to light them up. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cross three spaces per press; space activates alignment. RULE: Movement is strict and blocked by walls, requiring precise positioning to reach targets. TRAP: Assuming diagonal movement or smaller steps wastes actions; remember each arrow press covers three grid units.

GOAL: Replicate the left device's movement pattern on the right keypad to lift the plug sixteen units. CONTROLS: Click grid cells to toggle dashes and stems, matching the reference pattern exactly. RULE: The left machine’s active dash and stem configuration defines the correct upward motion. TRAP: Assuming clicks only affect the right keypad, ignoring that left interactions alter the reference pattern.

GOAL: Thread the straight rope through the ring’s hole. CONTROLS: Clicking anywhere instantly moves the head to that spot; the rope stays straight. RULE: The line from head to tail must pass through the ring’s center. TRAP: Thinking the head must stop inside the ring; it only needs to align the line.

GOAL: Clear the level by guiding three distinct shapes to consume all colored dots using a strict action budget. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the active shape; Spacebar cycles selection between the X, diamond, and plus symbols. RULE: Shapes consume dots only when their specific geometric arms or rings pass directly over them. TRAP: Assuming shapes can consume dots from any distance; you must physically traverse the grid to collect them.

GOAL: Rotate the ring to align the yellow block with the fixed yellow bracket at the top-left corner. CONTROLS: Click the red arrow to rotate the ring counter-clockwise, moving the yellow block one slot closer to the target. RULE: Each click shifts every item in the ring by one position in the direction of the arrow. TRAP: Do not assume the bracket moves; it is a static target, so you must move the block to it.

GOAL: Clear the board until only one peg remains standing. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it, then click a highlighted empty spot to jump over an adjacent peg into that space. RULE: A move is valid only if you jump directly over a neighboring peg into an empty hole, removing the jumped peg. TRAP: Believing you can move without jumping. Every move must eliminate a peg; moving into empty space is impossible.

GOAL: Guide the block to the exit icon to clear the level. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the block one grid step per press. RULE: Only paths through open gray floor spaces allow movement; charcoal shapes block passage. TRAP: Assuming the side glyphs indicate a hidden teleport mechanic rather than simple navigation.

GOAL: Guide shapes to collect dots by aligning them precisely with target boxes. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected shape; spacebar cycles to the next shape. RULE: The selector marker appears only at the active shape’s center, confirming which one moves. TRAP: Assuming the selector stays on the same shape; spacebar actually switches control, wasting moves if ignored.

GOAL: Move both objects into their matching rings. CONTROLS: Arrows slide the active object; click to switch which object you control. RULE: Only one object moves at a time; the other stays put until selected. TRAP: Assuming both objects move together or that rings block passage. Rings are open gates, not walls.

GOAL: Match the large grid colors to the pattern shown in the small center tile. CONTROLS: Click a large tile to flip its color between red and blue. RULE: White maps to red; gray maps to blue; the center cell stays fixed. TRAP: Assuming the small tile is just a legend; it is the exact target pattern for the surrounding large tiles.

GOAL: Match the grid colors to the pattern shown in the two mini panels. CONTROLS: Clicking a tile toggles its color between blue and orange. RULE: Each mini panel dictates the colors of its surrounding eight neighbors, with shared edges staying consistent. TRAP: Assuming the panels act independently rather than overlapping to form one unified pattern.

GOAL: Guide two separate characters through two asymmetric mazes to their respective exits using synchronized inputs. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both characters simultaneously in the same direction, regardless of their individual maze layouts. RULE: The mazes are not mirror images; obstacles are offset, requiring you to account for different wall positions for each character. TRAP: Assuming symmetry leads to failure, as a move that clears a wall for one character may crash the other into a shifted barrier.

ESTABLISHED: Packing R first blocks the arm from pushing N or b in row S4. FAILED: Pulling R left while N and b are still at home or in other rows. GOAL IS NOT: A simple left-to-right line in S4 if R is packed before N and b arrive. CONTROLS: UP/DOWN moves head; EXTEND pushes markers right; PULL LEFT moves arm and threaded markers left.

GOAL: Align two yellow markers at specific grid intersections. CONTROLS: Click green arrows to shift rows or columns. RULE: Only matching bracket shapes connect and move together. TRAP: Assuming independent movement; ignoring bracket linkage causes infinite loops and wasted clicks.

GOAL: Move two colored shapes to their matching home spots without overlapping forbidden zones. CONTROLS: Click a shape to grab it, click empty space to drop it, click a shape to swap its position with the held one. RULE: A shape only sticks when dropped directly onto its matching colored target area. TRAP: Thinking you can drop a shape anywhere first; placing it early can block the path for the second shape.

GOAL: Guide the yellow block to the left bracket and the orange block to the right bracket. CONTROLS: Rotate the left ring or the right ring to shift blocks along their respective paths. RULE: Rings move blocks independently, but shared cells allow a block to transfer from one ring to the other. TRAP: Do not assume rings are isolated; blocks on shared cells move differently depending on which ring you turn.

GOAL: Paint the plus orange and the cross green, then park them on matching colored dots. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the active shape; Space switched between the cross and the plus. RULE: Shapes only change color if they physically touch a box of that specific color. TRAP: Assuming shapes paint automatically; they remain neutral until they actually collide with a colored target.

ESTABLISHED: Moving down shifts the player. Spacebar teleports the player back to the start position. A gray marker appears at the spawn point when the player is away. FAILED: Pressing down repeatedly does not move the red block. Pressing spacebar does not clear the level. GOAL IS NOT: Simply reaching the blue ring is not the victory condition. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player. Spacebar drops a marker at the current spot and returns the player to the beginning.

GOAL: Paint a cross-shaped pattern using four overlapping blocks. CONTROLS: Click cells to change their color. RULE: Each block’s mini shows its base color as gray and its paint color as white. TRAP: Assuming conflicting overlaps made the puzzle unsolvable instead of prioritizing the paint color.

GOAL: Move the yellow and orange tokens to the bottom-right corner using twenty clicks. CONTROLS: Four arrows shifted entire rows left or right, and two columns up or down. RULE: Each click rotated a full line, moving tokens along the grid’s circular paths. TRAP: Assuming clicks only affected nearby cells; ignoring the full-line rotation caused wasted moves.

GOAL: Move specific colored blobs to target zones by carrying their roles. CONTROLS: Click near a body to swap its role with the head. Click empty space to move the head. RULE: The head always carries one role. Moving the head drags that role; clicking a body swaps roles instantly. TRAP: Thinking you can carry multiple items at once. You can only hold one role at a time, requiring careful swaps to position each color correctly.

GOAL: Align the plug's prongs with the socket pins to complete the circuit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the plug three grid units per press. RULE: Prongs must touch the socket's left edge without overlapping the body. TRAP: Assuming fine-grained movement; each key press shifts the plug by three full cells.

GOAL: Place both yellow blocks into the two bracketed spots on the top row. CONTROLS: Click red arrows to shift cells forward; click green arrows to shift them backward. RULE: The top row forms a small cycle, while the main grid follows a large loop connecting both cycles. TRAP: Assuming the two cycles are independent; you must coordinate shifts in both to align the blocks correctly.

GOAL: Replicate the hidden pattern by cycling tiles to their target colors. CONTROLS: Clicking a tile cycles its color through blue, red, and orange. RULE: Each block applies a fixed color map, where green always becomes red. TRAP: Assuming a simple toggle switch; tiles require three clicks to return to blue.

GOAL: Guide the shape so its mirror image perfectly covers the yellow target zone. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the physical shape; its reflection moves symmetrically across the central axis. RULE: The reflection is a fixed geometric mirror; aligning the physical shape dictates the reflection's position. TRAP: Assuming the reflection moves independently or requires separate control, wasting time on non-existent inputs.

GOAL: Align the reflection to the target zone. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active object. Space switches focus between the mirror bar and the shape. RULE: Moving the mirror bar shifts the reflection opposite to the shape’s position. TRAP: Believing moving the shape directly aligns the reflection; adjusting the mirror’s axis is often required.

GOAL: Match the grid to the target pattern. CONTROLS: Click tiles to toggle colors and flip neighbors. RULE: Only the small symbol overlays dictate the final colors; ignore the big tile backgrounds. TRAP: Assuming the large tiles’ colors were part of the solution, leading you to fight impossible conflicts instead of trusting the tiny hints.

GOAL: Navigate the green current through the circuit to reach the yellow box. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the green current; clicking plugs rotates bars or shifts blocks. RULE: Cells restore their original color when the green current leaves them, so paths remain open. TRAP: Believing the wire is consumed after use; it is not, so do not fear retracing steps.

GOAL: Fit the diamond and blob shapes into the lake's empty spaces without touching the gray frame. CONTROLS: Click a target to move the active shape to that center. RULE: Shapes must fit entirely on black pixels; water and frame pixels block movement. TRAP: Assuming a shape can hover over the frame; it cannot, so check all pixels carefully.

GOAL: Mirror two black shapes to cover four yellow targets using a reflection line. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected object; SPACE cycles selection; mouse clicks to pick items. RULE: Shapes must align perfectly with yellow dots; reflections only work if the line is positioned correctly between them. TRAP: Believing placement ends the puzzle; you must move the reflection line to cover the top targets after locking the shapes.

GOAL: Route yellow to start and green to end by balancing water levels. CONTROLS: Click gates to open them and move objects; click arrows to shift water between bands. RULE: Gates only open when adjacent water levels match the gate’s specific threshold. TRAP: Assuming clicking a gate moves an object regardless of water balance wastes actions; levels must align first.

GOAL: The plug needed to travel up eight units and right sixteen units to reach the exit. CONTROLS: Toggling the top dash moved the plug vertically, while toggling the middle stem moved it horizontally. RULE: Each column acted as a single instruction; the top dash signaled up and the middle stem signaled right. TRAP: Assuming all columns moved the plug the same way wasted time, as each column independently contributed its own directional vector.

ESTABLISHED: The map shifts down by 24 rows upon action. A block at rows 13-17 turns to water. FAILED: Clicking at 38,34 caused no change. Three left presses did not clear the level. GOAL IS NOT: Simply moving blocks left or clicking random empty spaces. CONTROLS: Left moves shift the view. Clicking specific coordinates triggers state changes like block-to-water.

ESTABLISHED: The can tilts to exactly half. Poses form a line: Left, Center, Right. Pouring at Right paints the bottom half. FAILED: Left and Right rotation clamped immediately. Clicking the can or legend did nothing. GOAL IS NOT: Filling the whole block. Painting the top half. Moving the block. CONTROLS: LEFT/RIGHT rotates the can one step within a fixed range. Pour action applies paint to the near half.

GOAL: Deliver power to the yellow box by activating hidden switches. CONTROLS: Arrows move the green cursor; clicking panel icons rotates colored bars. RULE: Entering specific sockets spawns new switch icons, allowing further bar rotations. TRAP: Assuming the red bar was already active; it only appeared after visiting the lower socket.

GOAL: Rotate three yellow markers on separate star shapes to their designated tips, then click the final button to win. CONTROLS: Clicking an arrow rotates all arms of that star. Right arrows move markers outward; down arrows spin them clockwise. RULE: Each star operates independently. Solve one star completely before moving to the next to avoid undoing previous progress. TRAP: Assuming rotations affect all stars simultaneously. They do not; focus on one star at a time to prevent confusion.

GOAL: Paint the top half of the block white. CONTROLS: Arrows move the can around the block's perimeter; Space tips it to paint. RULE: Only the North position paints the top half, requiring precise positioning. TRAP: Assuming the can rotates freely in place; it actually orbits the block, needing multiple moves to reach the North pose.

GOAL: Align the connector and colors to form the sequence red, blue, neutral, yellow, neutral, blue, red. CONTROLS: Click a piece to select it, then click a destination to swap positions. Press space to submit the arrangement. RULE: The green box must hold the blue connector on the left side, forcing the right slot to neutral. TRAP: Leaving a piece selected causes unintended swaps when clicking new targets, breaking the setup and wasting moves.

GOAL: Paint the grid with purple and orange to match the target, leaving the bottom-left corner white. CONTROLS: Arrows move the can around the perimeter; clicking swatches selects paint; space pours. RULE: A pour paints the entire half-plane defined by the can’s current edge orientation. TRAP: Assuming pours add color instead of replacing it caused wasted moves trying to layer paints.

GOAL: Float the bubble up to touch the ceiling marker. CONTROLS: Arrows move left or right; clicking breaks blocks. RULE: Breaking the ceiling block opens a shaft for the bubble to rise. TRAP: Thinking horizontal moves are blocked by the marker; they are not.

GOAL: Reach the target corner while dodging four moving guards that patrol specific rows and columns. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one step per turn; timing is critical as guards move simultaneously. RULE: You must arrive at the destination only when no guard occupies that cell; their paths create temporary safe windows. TRAP: Assuming a straight path is safe ignores guard schedules; you often need to wait or detour to avoid intersecting their patrol lines.

GOAL: Match two colored chains to their specific target rings. CONTROLS: Click an endpoint to grab it, then click empty space to move it. RULE: A chain absorbs a pot only when its center passes directly over it. TRAP: Grabbing an endpoint you are already holding does nothing, wasting your limited action count.

GOAL: Place both yellow tokens into their respective target brackets. CONTROLS: Arrows shift row items or move column tokens; side buttons rotate the second device. RULE: Row shifts rotate the second device’s orientation, requiring synchronized planning for both tokens. TRAP: Assuming arrow presses only affect the targeted token, ignoring how row shifts inadvertently rotate the second device’s position.

GOAL: Move the object across three water pockets by balancing their widths to open two gates. CONTROLS: Two handle pairs adjust pocket sizes; clicking a gate moves the object when adjacent waters align perfectly. RULE: A gate opens only when the waters on both sides exactly touch its edges, not when they overlap or fall short. TRAP: Assuming water could simply cover the gate area; it must meet the boundary precisely, requiring careful width adjustments.

GOAL: Fill specific grid regions with matching colored paint to satisfy the target pattern. CONTROLS: Arrows rotate the painter's orientation, mouse clicks select paint colors, and space applies the current color. RULE: Only the paint color matching the target region's hue can successfully fill that specific area. TRAP: Assuming any paint works everywhere; using the wrong color wastes a crucial action without changing the grid.

GOAL: Arrange the blue block to correctly overlay the yellow shape's gaps. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the selected piece; Space switched between blue pieces. RULE: The dots were holes revealing the color underneath, not separate objects. TRAP: I wasted time calculating pixel coverage, thinking the yellow bar was partially hidden, when it was simply split into disconnected segments by the overlay.

GOAL: Move the player away from the chasing diamond, then push the diamond far enough right to escape its range. CONTROLS: Clicking near the player moves them; clicking on the diamond pushes it away from the player. RULE: The diamond only reacts to clicks if the player is not the nearest object to the click point. TRAP: Clicking the diamond while too close grabs the player instead, causing them to move into the diamond and die.

GOAL: Split the block into two equal halves. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the cursor; SPACE pours the selected color; clicks select colors. RULE: The diagonal split divides the block exactly in half. TRAP: Wasting moves by wandering the board instead of walking the direct shortest path between spots.

GOAL: Fill the grid with four colored regions defined by geometric inequalities and a rectangle. CONTROLS: Arrows move the can, clicks select paint, space pours the large area, and clicking the small can pours the rectangle. RULE: Later pours overwrite earlier ones, so layer colors from largest background to smallest detail. TRAP: Believing every cell must be touched individually; using inequality-based region fills saves massive time.

GOAL: Collect all guards and reach the exit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move one step; stepping on a guard removes it. RULE: Approach guards from the side, never from the direction they face. TRAP: Believing you can walk through a guard's sightline to reach its back.

GOAL: Navigate a grid to collect a green item while avoiding red guards. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one cell in the chosen direction. RULE: Red guards attack only the cell directly in front of them, not their current position. TRAP: Assuming dark red guards behave differently than red ones; they follow the exact same movement and attack rules.

GOAL: Align the body with its reflection by moving lines and the shape to specific grid coordinates. CONTROLS: Arrows move the currently selected object; Spacebar cycles selection between the horizontal line, vertical line, and body. RULE: Objects pass through each other without blocking, allowing independent positioning of lines and the body. TRAP: Assuming lines block movement wastes time; you can move the body across lines freely without needing to clear paths first.

GOAL: The task required moving three shapes to cover specific colored dots within a limited action budget. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the active shape, while the spacebar switched control to the next shape. RULE: A shape only paints its assigned color when it completely covers the target dots. TRAP: Overlapping shapes can hide the selector, but the move still registers correctly despite the visual glitch.

GOAL: Pass both blocks through each other in a single move to swap their positions. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move each block independently by fixed pixel steps. RULE: Blocks exchange places instantly when they meet head-on in the same row. TRAP: Trying to swap sides by navigating around obstacles fails; they must collide directly.

GOAL: Align four glyph tiles to match target states A and D. CONTROLS: Arrows navigate cursor; UP/DOWN cycle glyph values; LEFT/RIGHT move selection. RULE: Wide tiles display paired glyphs that must match simultaneously to satisfy constraints. TRAP: Assuming all tiles cycle independently; wide tiles lock pairs, requiring specific paired values.

ESTABLISHED: The bar at row 4 fails to block leaks rising from row 3. Water spreads horizontally at row 5, then pours up through gaps, causing immediate leaks at blocks 6 and 14 before filling cups. FAILED: Placing the bar at column 10 or column 8. Neither position stopped the upward flow from the prong spreads, resulting in unavoidable leaks that prevented clearing the level. GOAL IS NOT: Filling all three cups simultaneously. The geometry forces a leak whenever a prong spread occurs, making a full fill impossible under current rules. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the bar. Space drops the bar. Th

GOAL: Align four shapes to fill the grid. CONTROLS: Space cycles selection; arrows move the chosen piece. RULE: Each shape has a unique dot count, letting you identify it by counting. TRAP: Believing selection resets; it persists, so pressing Space unnecessarily wastes moves and risks losing track.

ESTABLISHED: Moving toward the chaser causes death. Guards lunge when you are adjacent in their facing direction. FAILED: Trying to collect the chaser by closing distance. Assuming the chaser moves every turn regardless of alignment. GOAL IS NOT: Simply reaching the exit while ignoring the chaser's position. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player. Breaking line of sight may cause the chaser to pause.

GOAL: Guide the player to the yellow target by clearing the red bar's path. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player; clicking switches rotates bars. RULE: Rotate the red bar vertical to create a gap, then navigate around the purple walls. TRAP: Thinking you can walk through the red bar horizontally; you must rotate it first to pass.

GOAL: Move four shapes to their mirrored targets using the fewest steps. CONTROLS: Arrows slide the active shape; Space cycles selection among them. RULE: Shapes must land exactly on their reflection lines to unlock the exit. TRAP: Believing you must find the next shape by trial. The cycle order is fixed; memorize it to skip wasted Space presses.

GOAL: Move four shapes to specific target rings. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected shape. Clicks select a new shape. RULE: Shapes pass through ring frames without stopping. TRAP: Assuming ring borders block movement causes wasted turns.

ESTABLISHED: Pieces p, W, Y, and N have red tips that must align exactly to mate. Body overlaps are forbidden. FAILED: The previous solver allowed body-tip collisions, producing invalid solutions. Greedy mating with fixed pieces failed to find a valid path. GOAL IS NOT: Simply moving pieces until they touch. Overlapping non-tip cells breaks the puzzle. CONTROLS: Rotate pieces in 90-degree steps. Move one piece at a time. Mates require perfect 3x3 red block alignment.

ESTABLISHED: Clicking destroys a block plus the wall below it, but leaves the wall above intact. FAILED: Assuming clicks destroy both adjacent walls; the upper barrier remains, stopping the bubble from rising further. GOAL IS NOT: A single click clearing the entire vertical path to the top. CONTROLS: Clicking a block removes it and the barrier directly underneath, allowing the bubble to rise only into that specific gap.

GOAL: Guide the merged pair into the circular target zone. CONTROLS: Click near a dot to grab it, then click a destination to move it. RULE: Two separate dots merge into a single unit when brought close together. TRAP: Moving a single dot into the target fails; only the merged unit completes the level.

GOAL: Guide the marker to touch the head after removing red obstacles. CONTROLS: Arrows move the marker; dashes destroy red objects and clear paths. RULE: The marker wins by being adjacent to the head, not overlapping it. TRAP: Believing you must enter the head causes unnecessary moves; stopping next to it suffices.

ESTABLISHED: Pegs jump like checkers. The bottom panel holds a static peg. The top panel is the play area. FAILED: Clicking wires with no selection. Clicking the socket. Leaving one peg on the top panel. GOAL IS NOT: Simply reducing the top panel to a single peg. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it if a jump exists. Click a destination to jump. Clicking wires or sockets currently yields no visible result.

ESTABLISHED: The block's alignment is off by one column in the grid origin, creating phantom corridors. A corrected graph confirms the goal is reachable in 17 moves, not 13. FAILED: Previous pathfinding using the misaligned grid origin, which yielded an invalid 13-move solution due to shifted column indices. GOAL IS NOT: A 13-move path, as that result relied on incorrect passability data from the unaligned grid. CONTROLS: Standard movement applies. Ensure grid coordinates are aligned with the block's actual position before calculating distances.

ESTABLISHED: A green bar grows downward from a cap. A purple L-shape blocks the path below. A plus marker sits far below. FAILED: Moving the green bar down through the purple shape. Crossing the purple shape at lower rows. GOAL IS NOT: Placing the green bar on the plus center. CONTROLS: Moving the cap shifts the bar. Growing extends the bar until it hits an obstacle.

GOAL: Slide the block to fully cover the head. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the block exactly four spaces. RULE: The block stops only if the next four spaces are blocked. TRAP: Thinking partial overlap wins; you must align perfectly with the target.

GOAL: Move the player into the glowing circle. CONTROLS: Click a pixel on your sprite to jump in that direction. RULE: Clicking a specific body part determines your trajectory, allowing precise diagonal landings. TRAP: Believing you can move straight up; the shape forces diagonal steps, requiring zig-zagging to align with the target.

GOAL: Reach a horizontal adjacent pair in the same row to trigger the swap win condition. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both squares simultaneously, with their directions mirroring each other relative to the center. RULE: The level clears when the two squares are side-by-side and a horizontal arrow is pressed, causing them to cross. TRAP: Assuming squares cannot overlap or pass through each other prevents finding the necessary side-by-side configuration for the swap.

GOAL: Place two yellow shapes into their matching circles while avoiding chasers. CONTROLS: Click near a shape to drag it; click a chaser to push it away. RULE: Chasers pursue the nearest yellow shape, so position them to split attention. TRAP: Assuming circles protect shapes; chasers still target them, requiring active evasion.

GOAL: Guide the blue avatar to the target ring using eight precise moves. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift the character position; the spacebar activates the special ability. RULE: Moving onto a compatible blue zone merges the shapes to unlock the path. TRAP: Assuming the ring's outline blocks entry wastes time; blue boundaries are passable.

GOAL: Slide the plus symbol into the ring’s hole using only five arrow moves. CONTROLS: Arrows slide the player until hitting a wall or object; pushing an object shifts it one space. RULE: Objects block movement unless pushed, allowing you to reposition them for alignment. TRAP: Assuming ring frames block sliding; they are decorative and do not stop movement.

ESTABLISHED: Releasing the box at column 4 saves ten moves. The orange enemy chases the nearest free box, causing unheld boxes to dash into empty slots automatically. FAILED: Manually carrying the third and fourth boxes wastes time; the enemy’s pursuit delivers them to nearby empty cells for free. GOAL IS NOT: Placing every box by hand. The solution relies on using the enemy to push boxes into specific open spots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the head and attached box. Space releases the box.

ESTABLISHED: Six solids and two connectors must fit eight slots. Main box holds four items; blue box holds four. FAILED: Treating connectors as solid items causes immediate validation errors. Leaving slots empty fails. Ignoring the blue box fails. GOAL IS NOT: A simple linear sequence of six solids. Connectors are not invalid items to be ignored. CONTROLS: Click to swap items between boxes. Spacebar triggers validation. Animation shows item-by-item checks.

GOAL: Clear the level by positioning rope heads to hold tails in place, then reach the exit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player and displace rope heads; Space records your path to create a ghost that replays it, holding positions permanently. RULE: Rope heads stay displaced only while occupied by the player or a ghost; once free, they snap back to their tails. TRAP: Assuming displaced heads stay put after you move away; you must record a ghost path to maintain the displacement while you exit.

GOAL: Move the socket carrying a peg along the wire to the bottom panel and jump it into the final slot. CONTROLS: Arrows slide the socket along the wire; clicking a peg selects it, then clicking a target spot executes a jump. RULE: The socket acts as a carrier; the peg stays inside until you manually trigger the final jump to clear the board. TRAP: Assuming the socket stops at the panel border; you must position it adjacent to the target to allow the jump.

GOAL: Guide a block to a marked spot while managing energy and a changing pattern. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the block; energy drains with each step. RULE: Reaching a refill point restores energy, but you must leave and re-enter the marker to satisfy the pattern condition. TRAP: Thinking one visit to the marker suffices; ignoring the need for specific entry directions wastes actions.

GOAL: Clear the level in four moves. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift the marker chain. RULE: Markers hook onto the tip and pull together when retracted. TRAP: Assuming individual markers move independently rather than dragging contiguous neighbors.

GOAL: Place the orange block into the matching shape slot to clear the screen. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the block; the launcher flings it across gaps. RULE: The block only fits if its color and shape exactly match the target legend. TRAP: Ignoring the launcher’s path, trying to slide the block manually wastes moves.
